Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Welcome aboard.

Short answers up front: we support both methods (portal and email). Portal delivery is our recommended option for recurring customers — it provides secure storage, automatic invoice history, and the ability to attach the PO so your Accounts Payable can match documents easily. If you prefer email we can send a PDF to procurement@acme-health.com on each billing cycle.

If you choose the portal, next steps from our side: 
- I will create a billing contact account for whomever you specify (email we send invite to).
- The portal invitation includes a one-click link to accept and set password.
- We will attach the PO to each invoice and set the PO number field for automated matching.

For VAT: we will need your official VAT number (you included IT12345678901 — thanks). Finance needs to determine whether reverse-charge applies; I’ve looped in Marcus from our finance team to confirm routing and whether VAT should be zero-rated on the invoice.

Can you confirm the preferred billing contact (name and email) for portal invites and whether the billing email should receive monthly statements? Also confirm PO 45321 is the right number for the first invoice.

I’ve attached a short instructions PDF that shows what the portal email looks like and where the invoice/PO will appear.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise 
Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com

Hi Elena / Aisha,

Thanks for including me — a few finance notes to make sure the setup is compliant and smooth: 
- If Acme wants portal delivery, we will provision a billing portal account tied to the company record in our billing system. Portal invite needs a confirmed billing contact email (we typically require at least one primary + one backup).
- For portal customers we can: 1) push invoices to your procurement system (SFTP/API) on request, or 2) have the primary billing email download PDFs monthly.
- Payment terms for this account are NET30 unless otherwise negotiated in the SOW or purchase order. If you need NET45 we can consider it but need procurement approval.
- VAT handling: because this is B2B EU -> EU cross-border, if you are supplying a valid VAT ID we will apply reverse-charge (VAT 0%) and include your VAT ID and our statement on the invoice. Please confirm the VAT ID matches your company registry.
- Required docs: our accounting team needs a copy of your signed PO and a company registration/VAT certificate for our records. If you prefer, we can accept the PO and a screenshot of the VAT cert; otherwise use the vendor portal upload.

I’m also attaching our vendor tax form (Redwood_W-9.pdf) for your AP team to keep on file — it’s standard on our side.

Once Aisha confirms the billing contact, I’ll draft a sample invoice showing the reverse-charge line so you can verify the presentation.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations — Finance
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
